integrity: Unrestricted proof and labelled component generating functions are supplied. A separate executable verifies finite orders 4, 5 and 6; finite checks are not treated as proof. No independent mathematical validation or priority certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The formulas apply to triangular graphs L(K_n) with n at least 4.
The extreme P4-saturation edge values and the P4-saturation spectrum were known before this result.
An unindexed exact enumeration and full-text coverage of a related saturation-spectrum article remain priority risks.
title: Exact geodesic-transversal polynomials of triangular graphs from ordinary path saturation
